propositions: Completion verification fails without a verdict when primary run exhausts budget, enters duplicate-call loops, or hits token limits, leaving no scored outcome even with partial progress.

Recovery path fans out isolated LLM runs per criterion causing runaway context re-sends (22 criteria × 20-request budget worst case) and flat 100K-char context bound rejects live tickets (121,147 chars).
Duplicate read-only tool calls repeat identically within single runs (144× identical search_files observed) due to lack of memoization and model steering.
Context assembly lacks ranked pre-fetching of file_impact contents, forcing agentic read round-trips (67-82% of distinct reads are subtree-covered).
Banked per-criterion verdicts enable recovery to batched successor runs under request budget, guaranteeing full-coverage verdict finalization when any progress is recorded.
